description: Candid Health provides end-to-end revenue cycle management powered by AI that learns from your claim patterns. The platform automatically identifies coding errors, missing information, and payer-specific requirements before claims are submitted, dramatically reducing denials. With real-time denial management, automated appeals, and detailed analytics, Candid helps healthcare organizations achieve 95-99% net collection rates while significantly reducing manual RCM work.

faqs.q: What makes Candid Health different from traditional RCM?
faqs.a: Candid Health uses AI to proactively identify and correct claim errors before submission, rather than just processing claims. This 'autocorrection' approach prevents denials rather than managing them after the fact, leading to 95-99% net collection rates.

faqs.q: How much does Candid Health cost?
faqs.a: Candid Health uses a percentage-of-collections pricing model, typically 3-6% depending on volume and complexity. This aligns incentives—they only earn more when you collect more. There are no upfront costs or implementation fees.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Candid Health integrate with?
faqs.a: Candid Health has native integrations with Athenahealth, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, Elation Health, Canvas Medical, and many others. They also connect with major clearinghouses for seamless claims submission.

faqs.q: Is Candid Health good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes, Candid Health works with mental health practices and understands behavioral health billing nuances. However, for mental health-specific RCM with payer credentialing, also consider dedicated behavioral health billing services.
